country.evidence_quote: Back in the 1990s, four college grads working in the medical imaging department of McGill University Health Center in Montreal, Canada, discovered a problem. Storing and sharing vital medical images was a tedious, manual process that resulted in lots of errors. They banded together with a vision to create more accessible imaging solutions. This vision became Intelerad, which pioneered cloud-based medical imaging.
